original_findings_unchanged.evidence: The step says, “a wrong preceding state or message pair changes the cloud and both satellite codebook groups; each candidate is independent of the output and has product law.” A wrong candidate differing only in M1 while keeping the preceding state fixed leaves the cloud and user-2 codeword unchanged, so it is not independent of the output. For example, on the deterministic MAC Y=(X1,X2) with independent nondegenerate binary inputs, the pair-test likelihood ratio using P_Y has expectation 2^n for such candidates, not 1. These candidates are also caught by the user-1 test in 2.2, so partitioning them off repairs this proof-step gap.

The step asserts, “The no-feedback Gaussian sum bound from the same powers is 1/2 ln(1+2)=1/2 ln3.” Facts [F1] and [F2] supply the feedback region and feedback-code convention, not the no-feedback capacity bound. The separate scoped theorem thm-it-two-user-real-awgn-mac-capacity-region states the sum bound 1/2 ln(1+(P1+P2)/N), but this example does not cite it in its Facts or deps.
